subject: website
name: MYTHOS Arena
summary: MYTHOS Arena, a WebGL first-person shooter. Its bundle is minified with no source map and no public repository was found, so it stays at Level 2. It makes no request when it opens; multiplayer uses the GUN relay at vibing.at when the player chooses it.

connections.name: GUN relay (vibing.at/gun)
connections.note: Contacted only when multiplayer is chosen.
